name: Helen Keller International
mission: Guided by our founder’s remarkable legacy, Helen Keller Intl works to improve the lives of people around the world by protecting vision, enhancing nutrition, and fighting disease.
theoryOfChange: Helen Keller envisions a world where no one is deprived of the opportunity to live a healthy life and reach their true potential. We help millions of children and family members live healthier lives – helping them grow and access nutritious food, stave off malnutrition, build strong immune systems, access life-saving medical treatments, andprevent and treat blindness and vision loss. By providing the right support at the right time, we’re not only helping communities make positive changes today, but also creating positive ripples for generations to come.

rich_narrative.summary: Helen Keller International operates global health programs aimed at preventing blindness and reducing malnutrition among vulnerable populations [14]. This spending beats the <cite id="1">75% industry standard benchmark</cite>, demonstrating that the majority of resources directly fund field operations across Asia, Africa, and the United States [14]. Despite this contraction, the organization maintains exceptional financial stability with <cite id="1">18.6 months of working capital in reserves</cite>, ensuring operational continuity across its sight-saving and nutrition initiatives [14].
